@@ -0,0 +1,56 @@
+from typing import Annotated
+
+from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Response
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from starlette.responses import JSONResponse
+
+app = FastAPI()
+
+
+def modify_response() -> Response:
+    return JSONResponse(content={"message": "modified"})
+
+
+@app.get("/annotated")
+def endpoint_annotated(response: Annotated[Response, Depends(modify_response)]):
+    return {"response_type": type(response).__name__}
+
+
+@app.get("/default")
+def endpoint_default(response: Response = Depends(modify_response)):
+    return {"response_type": type(response).__name__}
+
+
+@app.get("/regular")
+def endpoint_regular(response: Response):
+    response.headers["X-Custom"] = "regular"
+    return {"response_type": type(response).__name__}
+
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+
+def test_annotated():
+    response = client.get("/annotated")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.json() == {"response_type": "JSONResponse"}
+
+
+def test_default():
+    response = client.get("/default")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.json() == {"response_type": "JSONResponse"}
+
+
+def test_regular():
+    response = client.get("/regular")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.headers["X-Custom"] == "regular"
+    assert response.json() == {"response_type": "Response"}
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_annotated()
+    test_default()
+    test_regular()
+    print("All tests passed!")
